Manage built-in automation hooks the same way as feature flags: persisted JSON
under .zqk/agent-runtime/cli_hook_profile.json.

Hooks are stable IDs (e.g. post_commit_scan_tests) that git hooks or scripts can
query. Optional tray_entry points at a zqk tray name for delegated commands.

Flags:
    --ignore-scheduler-down
      Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown

  List hooks
  zqk system cli-hooks list
  Disable post-commit test scheduling
  zqk system cli-hooks disable post_commit_scan_tests
  Shell: exit 1 if hook disabled
  zqk system cli-hooks is-enabled post_commit_scan_tests
  Machine: tray name for shell capture
  zqk system cli-hooks print-tray-entry post_commit_scan_tests
  Bind a tray entry
  zqk system cli-hooks set-tray post_commit_scan_tests scheduler-activity

Usage:
  zqk system cli-hooks [command] [args] [flags]

Flags:
      --columns string          Override column widths for table output (format: field:width)
  -f, --format string           Output format (table, json, jsonl, yaml, csv, json-rpc, stream, agent-prompt, semantic-link) (default "table")
      --ignore-scheduler-down   Ignore scheduler down warning/lockdown
  -o, --output string           Write output to file
  -q, --quiet                   Suppress non-essential output
      --timeout duration        Timeout for command execution (0 = auto-calculate)
  -v, --verbose                 Verbose output

Global Flags:
      --allow-degraded   Allow scheduler-dependent commands to run when scheduler daemon is not running
